children: Lisata appointed Ted W. Love, M.D. to its Board of Directors effective September 17, 2026, pursuant to the Merger Agreement.
Appointment in accordance with the Merger Agreement

Former Chairman of Marea; Immediate Past Chairman of Biotechnology Innovation Organization; ex-CEO of Global Blood Therapeutics; prior senior roles at Genentech, Onyx, Nuvelo; board roles at Gilead, Royalty Pharma, Jazz, Structure Therapeutics; MD from Yale.
